title: Thursday - Ziyarat of Imam Hasan Askari (a)
categoryChain: Thursday - Ziyarat of Imam Hasan Askari (a)
introduction:
ZIYARAH OF IMAM HASAN AL ASKARI (A) ON THURSDAY

This day is dedicated to Imam al-Hasan ibn Ali al-’Askari, peace be upon him. So, when you visit him on Thursdays, you are recommended to say the following:

verses.translation: Peace be upon you, O saint of Allah!

verses.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا حُجَّةَ اللّٰهِ وَ خَالِصَتَهُ
verses.translation: Peace be upon you, O argument of Allah and His choicest!
Peace be upon you, O leader of the faithful believers,
and argument of the Lord of the Worlds!

verses.arabic: صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْكَ وَ عَلٰى اٰلِ بَيْتِكَ
verses.translation: May Allah send peace upon you and upon your Household,

verses.arabic: اَنَا مَوْلًى لَكَ وَ لِاٰلِ بَيْتِكَ
verses.translation: I am a servant of you and of your Household

verses.arabic: وَ هٰذَا يَوْمُكَ وَ هُوَ يَوْمُ الْخَمِيْسِ
verses.translation: and today is your day, which is Thursday,

verses.arabic: وَ اَنَا ضَيْفُكَ فِيْهِ وَ مُسْتَجِيْرٌ بِكَ فِيْهِ
verses.translation: and on this day, I am your guest and in your vicinity;
so, receive me hospitably as your guest and neighbor,
[I ask you] in the name of your Household, the pure and immaculate.
